speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: SCREWED FEMORAL NECK (AVASCULAR NECROSIS) OF THE LEFT FEMORAL NECK.

The child's age (7 years old) and the presentation of unilateral left knee pain with a limp, despite having no fever or trauma, are highly suggestive of slipped capital femoral epiphysis (SCFE). Although the pain is referred to the knee, the physical exam will likely reveal tenderness in the hip and limited internal rotation. I will request an X-ray of the left hip to confirm the diagnosis.
